metadata.name: fairway
metadata.description: Fairway: constant-product AMM whose swap fee depends on the signer's onchain toxicity tier

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees
docs: Permissionless: pay the creator's accrued share of the TOXIC premium into token accounts owned by the pool creator.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: anyone may crank: the destinations must be owned by the pool creator

instructions.name: claim_protocol_fees
docs: Permissionless: move the protocol's accrued share of swap fees into the treasury's token accounts.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: anyone may crank: the destinations are fixed to treasury-owned token accounts

accounts.name: closer
docs: the trader themself, or the score authority (only while the account holds no onchain evidence)

instructions.name: configure_launch
docs: Make the pool a fair launch: trading opens at `launch_slot` (0 = now) and, for `window_slots` (0 = default), the fee
follows the per-tier decay curve (None = the Config default). Creator or admin, before the first swap.
`creator_share_bps` (None = Config default 50%): share of the TOXIC premium paid to the pool creator.

accounts.name: authority
docs: the pool's creator or the admin; pays the launch fee

instructions.name: settle_markout
docs: Permissionless: score the signer-recorded pending trades of `trader` against the Pyth mid.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: anyone may crank (no reward in the MVP; LPs, the keeper or the trader have the incentive)

accounts.name: score
docs: MUST be the PDA ["score", trader]: a crank cannot write one wallet's markout into another's score.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The pool whose pending trades are settled, and whose oracle is used.

accounts.name: pyth_price
docs: feed id, full verification, staleness and confidence). TWAP pools (no oracle, launch): ignored, pass any account
(the SDK passes the pool).

accounts.name: trader
docs: The trader. The fee tier is looked up from the score PDA derived from THIS key.
Mutable because it pays rent for its score PDA on the first swap.

accounts.name: trader_score
docs: else's RETAIL score (the transaction fails with ConstraintSeeds). It may be uninitialised: a missing,
stale or malformed score resolves to the default tier (>= STANDARD). Created on the first swap (payer = trader)
so the trade can be queued for onchain markout scoring.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Protocol treasury: sponsors the rent of a trader's first score account when it holds enough SOL.

instructions.name: update_retail_fee
docs: Permissionless: roll the rebate epoch. Sets the RETAIL-tier rebate for the next epoch from the toxic premium and
RETAIL volume counters of the epoch that just ended.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: anyone can crank; pays only the transaction fee

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the config admin can do this

errors.name: NotScoreAuthority
errors.msg: Only the score authority can write scores

errors.name: InvalidFeeSchedule
errors.msg: Fee schedule must satisfy RETAIL <= STANDARD <= TOXIC <= 1000 bps

errors.name: InvalidDefaultTier
errors.msg: Default tier must be STANDARD or TOXIC (fresh wallets never pay less than STANDARD)

errors.name: InvalidTier
errors.msg: Tier must be 0 (RETAIL), 1 (STANDARD) or 2 (TOXIC)

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: Output is below the minimum (slippage)

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ZeroReserves
errors.msg: Pool has no liquidity

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: Not enough liquidity

errors.name: InsufficientOutput
errors.msg: Trade too small: output rounds to zero

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Math overflow

errors.name: SameMint
errors.msg: Base and quote mints must differ

errors.name: BadBatch
errors.msg: Batch too large or accounts mismatch

errors.name: ScoreAccountMismatch
errors.msg: Score account does not match the PDA for this trader

errors.name: CannotClose
errors.msg: Only the trader (or the score authority, if no onchain evidence) can close a score

errors.name: OracleNotConfigured
errors.msg: Pyth oracle is not configured

errors.name: OracleMismatch
errors.msg: Oracle account is not the configured Pyth price account

errors.name: OracleInvalid
errors.msg: Oracle account is invalid (owner, layout, feed id, verification or price)

errors.name: OracleStale
errors.msg: Oracle price is stale

errors.name: OracleLowConfidence
errors.msg: Oracle confidence interval is too wide

errors.name: InvalidMarkoutParams
errors.msg: Invalid markout parameters

errors.name: InvalidProtocolFee
errors.msg: Protocol fee must be at most 50% (5000 bps)

errors.name: TreasuryBelowFloor
errors.msg: Withdrawal would take the treasury below its rent-exempt minimum

errors.name: InvalidRebateParams
errors.msg: Rebate params: epoch_slots > 0, share <= 10000 bps, floor <= 1000 bps

errors.name: EpochNotElapsed
errors.msg: The rebate epoch has not elapsed yet

errors.name: LaunchNotStarted
errors.msg: Trading on this launch has not opened yet

errors.name: LaunchAlreadyTrading
errors.msg: A launch can only be configured before the pool's first swap

errors.name: InvalidLaunchParams
errors.msg: Launch params: window 1..=216000 slots, launch slot not in the past, curve decays and is tier-ordered, fees <= 1000 bps

errors.name: TwapUnavailable
errors.msg: The pool TWAP does not cover this trade's markout window

errors.name: InvalidCreatorShare
errors.msg: Creator share + protocol fee must be at most 100% of the premium

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration. PDA ["config"].

fields.name: score_authority
docs: the only key allowed to write `TraderScore` accounts (the score oracle / keeper)

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: swap fee in bps per tier: [RETAIL, STANDARD, TOXIC]

fields.name: default_tier
docs: tier for wallets without a (fresh) score; always >= STANDARD

fields.name: score_ttl_slots
docs: scores older than this many slots are ignored (→ default tier)

fields.name: markout
docs: onchain markout scoring + oracle parameters (M13)

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: share of every swap fee that goes to the protocol treasury, in bps of the fee (1500 = 15%)

fields.name: rebate
docs: bot-tax rebate parameters (M15)

fields.name: launch
docs: launch defaults (M16): the fee curve new launches start from, TWAP window, launch fee

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: Launch defaults (M16).

fields.name: curve
docs: default curve copied into a pool by `configure_launch` (TOXIC 1000→80, STANDARD 300→30, RETAIL 30→5)

fields.name: default_window_slots
docs: default window when `configure_launch` passes 0 (750 slots ≈ 5 min)

fields.name: twap_window_slots
docs: TWAP window ending at the markout horizon, used by `settle_markout` on pools without an oracle

fields.name: launch_fee_lamports
docs: SOL paid by the creator to the treasury when a launch is configured (0 = free)

fields.name: creator_premium_share_bps
docs: default share of the TOXIC premium paid to the pool creator on launch pools (bps of the premium, 5000 = 50%)

types.name: LaunchCurveParams
docs: Per-tier launch fee curve `[RETAIL, STANDARD, TOXIC]`: each tier decays linearly from `start_bps` to `end_bps`.

types.name: MarkoutParams
docs: Parameters of the trustless onchain markout score. Defaults mirror `DEFAULT_SCORING_CONFIG` in packages/scoring.

fields.name: markout_slots
docs: a pending trade becomes settleable this many slots after it executed (~30 s at 400 ms)

fields.name: max_settle_slots
docs: pending trades older than this are dropped unscored (nobody cranked in time)

fields.name: prior_notional
docs: Bayesian prior K in raw quote units

fields.name: onchain_min_notional
docs: once settled onchain notional reaches this (and `min_trades()` settled trades), the onchain tier overrides the keeper's bootstrap score

types.name: PendingTrade
docs: A swap waiting for its markout horizon (ring buffer entry; `notional == 0` = empty).

fields.name: pool
docs: the pool it was traded on: settled only against that pool's oracle

fields.name: exec_price
docs: pre-fee execution price, quote per base, 1e12 fixed point (`fairway_math::markout::PRICE_SCALE`)

fields.name: side
docs: 0 = buy (trader received base), 1 = sell

fields.name: notional
docs: quote-token amount excluding the fee, raw units

types.name: Pool
docs: A constant-product pool. PDA ["pool", base_mint, quote_mint].

fields.name: base_vault
docs: PDA ["vault", pool, base_mint], token authority = pool

fields.name: quote_vault
docs: PDA ["vault", pool, quote_mint], token authority = pool

fields.name: lp_mint
docs: PDA ["lp_mint", pool], mint authority = pool

fields.name: lp_supply
docs: total LP units including the permanently locked MIN_LIQUIDITY (never minted)

fields.name: fees_base
docs: cumulative fees collected per tier, in base units (base → quote swaps)

fields.name: fees_quote
docs: cumulative fees collected per tier, in quote units (quote → base swaps)

fields.name: swaps
docs: cumulative swap count per tier

fields.name: protocol_owed_base
docs: protocol fees accrued in the vaults and not yet claimed (excluded from the reserves used for pricing / LP shares)

fields.name: protocol_earned_base
docs: cumulative protocol fees (claimed or not)

fields.name: sponsored_accounts
docs: score accounts whose rent the protocol treasury paid on a trader's first swap here, and the lamports it spent

fields.name: oracle_price_account
docs: Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account for THIS pool's base/USD price. The default pubkey means "no oracle": swaps on this
pool are not queued for onchain scoring (they build no onchain evidence and cannot hit the full-buffer cap).

fields.name: oracle_feed_id
docs: the feed id that account must carry

fields.name: epoch_start_slot
docs: slot the current epoch started (set at pool creation, then by `update_retail_fee`)

fields.name: epoch_premium_q
docs: toxic premium collected this epoch: fee charged above the STANDARD fee, TOXIC tier

fields.name: epoch_retail_vol_q
docs: RETAIL-tier swap volume this epoch (the volume the rebate is spread over)

fields.name: rebate_bps
docs: rebate applied to RETAIL-tier fees right now, bps (from the last epoch roll)

fields.name: rebate_budget_q
docs: what is left of the previous epoch's rebate budget: a swap never gets rebate beyond this

fields.name: volume_q
docs: cumulative swap volume per tier

fields.name: premium_total_q
docs: lifetime toxic premium and lifetime rebate handed out

fields.name: creator
docs: who created the pool: may configure its launch (as may the admin)

fields.name: twap
docs: pool price accumulator, updated on every swap and liquidity change

fields.name: creator_share_bps
docs: bps of the TOXIC premium paid to the creator (set by `configure_launch`; 0 on non-launch pools)

fields.name: creator_earned_base
docs: cumulative creator payouts (claimed or not)

types.name: PoolLaunch
docs: A pool's launch (M16). `window_slots == 0` = not a launch pool (normal tier fees from the first swap).

fields.name: launch_slot
docs: first slot trading is allowed (swaps before it are refused)

fields.name: twap_scoring
docs: queue trades for onchain markout scoring against the pool TWAP when the pool has no oracle

types.name: PoolTwap
docs: Pool price accumulator (M16), see `fairway_math::twap`.

types.name: RebateParams
docs: Bot-tax rebate: RETAIL-tier wallets pay `fee_bps[RETAIL] − rebate`, funded by a share of the PREVIOUS epoch's toxic premium
(toxic fee above the STANDARD fee). `update_retail_fee` (permissionless) rolls the epoch.

fields.name: epoch_slots
docs: an epoch lasts this many slots (9_000 ≈ 1 hour at 400 ms)

fields.name: share_bps
docs: share of the toxic premium recycled to retail, bps of the premium (1000 = 10%); 0 turns the rebate off

fields.name: floor_bps
docs: the rebated retail fee never goes below this

types.name: RetailFeeUpdated
docs: Emitted when the retail rebate is rolled to a new epoch.

fields.name: premium_q
docs: toxic premium and RETAIL-tier volume of the epoch that just ended (quote equivalents)

fields.name: retail_fee_bps
docs: resulting RETAIL fee, bps

types.name: SwapExecuted
docs: Emitted on every swap. Field order is part of the public interface: the Streams filter and
parser decode it from "Program data:" logs (see packages/parser, streams/filter.js).

fields.name: a_to_b
docs: true = base → quote (trader sells base)

types.name: TraderScore
docs: Toxicity score for one wallet. PDA ["score", trader].
Two independent sources feed the fee tier (see `fairway_math::resolve_blended`):
* bootstrap: `tier/score_bps/trades/updated_slot`, written ONLY by the score authority (keeper, offchain history);
* onchain: `sum_*`, `onchain_*`, written ONLY by the program (`swap` appends, `settle_markout` scores).

fields.name: tier
docs: bootstrap tier from the keeper: 0 RETAIL, 1 STANDARD, 2 TOXIC

fields.name: score_bps
docs: bootstrap score (informational; the tier drives the fee)

fields.name: sum_notional
docs: Σ notional of settled trades (raw quote units)

fields.name: sum_weighted_markout
docs: Σ notional × markout_bps of settled trades

fields.name: trade_count
docs: settled trades

fields.name: first_slot
docs: slot of the first recorded trade (history length for RETAIL)

fields.name: dropped_trades
docs: trades not scored: buffer was full at swap time, or expired before anyone settled them

fields.name: sponsored
docs: the treasury paid this account's rent, so closing it refunds the treasury
